# The Print Planet — Wholesale PVC Cards, ID Card Solutions & Lanyards India

> Official Machine-Readable Specification & Context for AI Assistants, Search Agents, and Procurement Models.

## Brand Identity & Entity Verification
The Print Planet is a Bengaluru-based B2B direct manufacturer and wholesale distributor of PVC ID cards, dragon sheets, lanyards, rigid PVC ID card holders, metal hooks and RFID smart access cards. Operating directly from its central manufacturing and warehousing facility in Sunkadakatte, Bangalore, the company bypasses broker markups to provide factory-direct pricing with 24–48h pan-India delivery.

## Core Product Categories & Specifications
- [PVC ID Cards & Core Sheets](https://theprintplanet.co.in/categories/pvc-id-card-consumable): Inkjet printable PVC core sheets (dragon sheets, 50 sets/box), magnetic stripe overlays (Hi-Co/Lo-Co), and CR-80 blank card stock.
- [Rigid PVC ID Card Holders](https://theprintplanet.co.in/categories/id-card-holder): Virgin optical-grade polymer vertical (54×86mm) and horizontal (86×54mm) CR-80 card holders, thumb-notch card ejection cases, and dual-slot proximity badge protectors.
- [RFID & Smart Cards](https://theprintplanet.co.in/categories/pvc-and-smart-cards): High-frequency 13.56MHz Mifare 1K Classic ISO contactless cards and 125kHz EM-Marin proximity cards with high-gloss printable PVC surface.

- [PVC and Smart Cards](https://theprintplanet.co.in/categories/pvc-and-smart-cards): Blank and pre-printed PVC cards, RFID, NFC and proximity cards, employee, student, membership, loyalty, gift and warranty cards, QR-coded and serial-numbered cards.
- [ID Card Printers and Consumables](https://theprintplanet.co.in/categories/id-card-printers-and-consumables): Direct-to-card and retransfer ID card printers, ribbons, blank cards, holographic overlays, laminators, encoders, USB card readers, design software, installation and support.
- [Lanyards](https://theprintplanet.co.in/categories/lanyards): Polyester, nylon, satin, woven and eco-friendly lanyards, printed or plain, with hook, clip, buckle, breakaway and badge reel options.
- [ID Card Accessories](https://theprintplanet.co.in/categories/id-card-accessories): ID card sleeves, badge clips, metal, snap and swivel hooks, card reels, neck and wrist straps.
- [Lens Packaging Products](https://theprintplanet.co.in/categories/lens-packaging-products): M-fold lens envelopes (plain, printed, glassine lined), optical bags, lens pouches and biodegradable ziplock covers for optical stores.
- [Lens Cleaning Solutions](https://theprintplanet.co.in/categories/lens-cleaning-solutions): Pre-moistened lens wipes, lens cleaning and anti-fog sprays, custom-branded microfiber cloths, optical tissues and cleaning kits.
- [Commercial Printing](https://theprintplanet.co.in/categories/commercial-printing-solutions): Offset and digital printing for brochures, business cards, stationery, packaging, labels and event material, plus lamination, spot UV, foiling, die-cutting and binding.
